qa.question: If the "when you use an Option card" effect triggers, what is the timing when it can activate?
qa.answer: It can be activated after activating the used Option card's [Main] effect.

qa.question: Does the "when you use an Option card" effect trigger if an Option card's effect activates by a method other than using the card?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If an Option card's effect activates without using it, such as activation by a [Security] effect or <Delay>, the "when you use an Option card" effect doesn't trigger.

qa.question: An Option card's use cost is 1 or less when used from the hand due to an effect such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s 1st effect. When such a card is used, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If a card's cost itself is reduced when it's used from the hand, it's considered to be using an Option card with a use cost after the reduction is applied. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect doesn't trigger.

qa.question: An Option card has an original use cost of 2 or more, and I use it when the cost to pay is reduced to 1 or less. At such times, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
qa.answer:
Yes, it triggers.
If the card's cost to pay is reduced and not the use cost itself, it's considered to be using an Option card with its original value as its use cost. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect triggers.

qa.question: I used an effect to use an Option card with an original use cost of 2 or more without paying the cost. At such times, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, it triggers.

qa.question: Does this card’s inherited effect activate when my opponent suspends a Digimon by blocking?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "return 1 of your other Digimon to its owner's hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand, then return up to 2 of my opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to their owners' hands?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to place my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] on top of my security stack from the battle area?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to place in the security stack, according to the rules it will be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the security stack.
A card isn't actually added to the security stack, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the security stack" don't trigger.

qa.question: If I choose my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] or token that is treated as a Digimon in the battle area as the target for this card's effect, it isn't placed in the security stack. In such cases, do "when a card is removed from the security stack" effects trigger because a card wasn't added to the security stack even though it normally should have been added?
qa.answer: No, they don’t trigger.

qa.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper], and this card is the bottom card. Does the "you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0" effect activate when my [EX2-055 Reaper] is played?
qa.answer: It can activate in such cases if you declare to trash 8 cards and then trash 7 cards except for [BT9-109 X Antibody].

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

qa.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand, what happens for "return 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose level is less than or equal to the returned Digimon's level to the hand"?
qa.answer: [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is a Digimon without a level, therefore your opponent can't return a Digimon to the hand.

qa.question: Can this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect move a level 2 Digimon or cards like [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] or [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] from the breeding area to the battle area?
qa.answer: It can't move level 2 Digimon or cards like [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] because cards without DP can't be moved to the battle area. It can move [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] because it has DP.

qa.question: Does this card go in my deck, or my Digi-Egg deck?
qa.answer: This card is a Digi-Egg card, so it goes in your Digi-Egg deck.

qa.question: When I hatch this card during my breeding phase, do I place it in my breeding area, or my battle area?
qa.answer: It’s placed in your breeding area as a level-less Digimon.

qa.question: This card doesn't have a level. Can I still digivolve it into other cards?
qa.answer: No. Cards that don't have levels can't be digivolved from. (Other than through special digivolutions.)

qa.question: If this card is in my breeding area, how do I move it to my battle area?
qa.answer:
It can be moved from your breeding area to your battle area like any other Digimon.
Level 2 Digimon don't have DP, and therefore can't be moved to your battle area. This card has DP, which means it can be moved to your battle area without digivolving it.

qa.question: If this card is in my breeding area, can I activate its [Main] effect to place my [ADR-02 Searcher] in its digivolution cards?
qa.answer: No, you can’t activate effects in the breeding area.

qa.question: If this card is in my battle area, can it be attacked by my opponent’s Digimon with an effect that reads “This Digimon can also attack unsuspended Digimon”?
qa.answer:
Yes, it can.
“This Digimon can also attack unsuspended Digimon” is an effect that only affects the Digimon that has it, so this card's “This Digimon [...] isn't affected by your opponent’s effects” effect can’t be used to prevent the attack.

qa.question: This card is in my battle area. If an opponent’s Digimon attacks it, and this card’s DP is less than or equal to the opponent’s Digimon, is this card deleted?
qa.answer: Yes, this card can be deleted as a result of battle.

qa.question: Is this Digimon affected by effects like “Delete 1 of your Digimon,” or “Suspend 1 of your Digimon” that I activate?
qa.answer: Yes, this card is affected by effects you activate.

qa.question: If this card is in my battle area, can my own effects delete it or move it to my hand/deck/security stack?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
However, since this card is a Digi-Egg card, note that if this card would be moved to your hand, deck, or security stack, it’s instead placed at the bottom of your Digi-Egg deck face down.

qa.question: If I play two cards with [D-Reaper] in their traits, can I choose not to activate this card’s [Your Turn] effect for the first card, and activate it for the second?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: My opponent has [BT8-071 Psychemon] in play. Can this Digimon’s [Your Turn] effect still reduce the play cost of cards with [D-Reaper] in their traits when I would play them?
qa.answer: No. [BT8-071 Psychemon]’s effect doesn’t target Digimon themselves, so you can’t activate this card's effect to reduce the play cost of cards.

qa.question: If I use [BT4-105 Tactical Retreat!] on this card, can I place it on top of my security stack face down?
qa.answer: No. This card is a Digi-Egg card, so if it would be moved to your security stack, it’s instead placed at the bottom of your Digi-Egg deck face down.

qa.question: Can I specify my opponent’s [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] as the target of an effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If an effect that targets multiple Digimon is also targeting my opponent's [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper], is the effect canceled, preventing it from affecting the other targeted Digimon?
qa.answer: No. It’s only this Digimon that isn't affected. The other Digimon will be affected as normal.

qa.question: I have an [ADR-02 Searcher] with 1 or more digivolution cards in play. If I place it in this Digimon's digivolution cards with this card's [Main] effect, do I also get to place [ADR-02 Searcher]’s digivolution cards under it as well?
qa.answer: No. You will only place the topmost [ADR-02 Searcher] in this Digimon’s digivolution cards. All of [ADR-02 Searcher]’s digivolution cards are trashed.

qa.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under this card, and [BT9-109 X Antibody] is the bottom card. Does the "you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0" effect activate when my [EX2-055 Reaper] is played?
qa.answer: It can activate in such cases if you declare to trash 8 cards and then trash 7 cards except for [X Antibody].

qa.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under my EX2-007 [Mother D-Reaper], including 1 BT9-109 [X Antibody]. Can this card's 1st effect activate when this card would be played?
qa.answer: Yes, it can be activated. As long as you can trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom other than cards that can't be trashed, the play cost will be 0.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the security stack, reveal all cards in my opponent's security stack, and place 1 card among them at the top of my opponent's deck?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to place in the security stack, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the security stack according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by placing 1 Digimon on top of its owner's security stack" condition. A card isn't actually added to the security stack, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the security stack" don't trigger.

qa.question: If I choose my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] or token that is treated as a Digimon in the battle area as the target for this card's [When Digivolving] effect, it isn't placed in the security stack. In such cases, do "when a card is removed from the security stack" effects trigger because a card wasn't added to the security stack even though it normally should have been added?
qa.answer: No, it doesn’t trigger.

qa.question: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a card with [Growlmon] or [Gallantmon] in its name or [Takato Matsuki], can I still add a card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as either a card with [Growlmon] or [Gallantmon] in its name or [Takato Matsuki] is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If both a card with [Growlmon] or [Gallantmon] in its name and [Takato Matsuki] are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining card at the bottom of my deck?
qa.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 card [...] and 1 [Takato Matsuki] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible. In this case, you must add both 1 card with [Growlmon] or [Gallantmon] in its name, and 1 [Takato Matsuki] to your hand.

qa.question: If [EX2-008 Guilmon]’s [On Play] effect reveals this card from my deck, can I add it to my hand as a card that has [Gallantmon] in its name?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: What does an "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" effect do?
qa.answer:
Such effects increase the maximum value shown for DP-based deletion effects.
For example, while "[Your Turn] Add 1000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" is activated, "[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less" will allow you to delete an opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.

qa.question: If "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" is activating, can the maximum be increased for an effect such as "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP" that references a Digimon's DP for deletion?
qa.answer:
No, it can't be increased.
You can't increase the maximum of a DP-based deletion effect that doesn't show a numerical value.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect add 1000 to the maximum DP I can choose with other effects, or just the effects on the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards?
qa.answer: It adds 1000 to the maximum DP you can choose with all of your effects.

qa.question: What does an "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" effect do?
qa.answer:

qa.answer:
No, it can't be increased.
You can't increase the maximum of a DP-based deletion effect that doesn't show a numerical value.

qa.question: Is this card’s [When Attacking] “Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to 6000 or less and delete them” effect also affected by its “add 2000 to the maximum DP you can choose with DP-based deletion effects” effect?
qa.answer:
Yes, it is.
If you have a red Tamer in play, you can choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to 8000 or less.

qa.question: Does this card's “add 2000 to the maximum DP you can choose with DP-based deletion effects” effect also raise the maximum DP I can choose with other deletion effects besides those on this card?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: This card’s [When Digivolving] effect reads “Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 10000 DP or less. If no Digimon was deleted by this effect...” What situations does “If no Digimon was deleted by this effect” refer to, specifically?
qa.answer: If no Digimon was deleted by this effect” refers to a state in which, when resolving this Digimon’s [When Digivolving] effect, your opponent doesn't have a Digimon with 10000 DP or less in play, or you try to delete an opponent's suitable Digimon can't be deleted with the effect. Essentially, if you didn't delete a Digimon by “Delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with 10000 DP or less,” follow the instructions listed after “If no Digimon was deleted by this effect...

qa.question: My opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or less in play. Can I choose not to delete my opponent’s Digimon with this card’s [When Digivolving] effect so we both trash the top 5 cards of our deck?
qa.answer:
No. If there’s a valid target in play, you must choose it with the effect.
You can't choose to NOT activate the effect.

qa.question: My opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or less and an effect that reads, “This Digimon can't be deleted by your opponent’s effects,” and another Digimon with 10000 DP or less but no effect. Can I intentionally have this card’s [When Digivolving] effect target the Digimon with the effect preventing deletion to have us both trash the top 5 cards of our decks?
qa.answer: Yes. You can choose your opponent’s Digimon with 10000 DP or less as a target, even if the chosen Digimon has an effect that prevents it from being deleted, in order to get the “if no Digimon was deleted by this effect” part of the effect.

qa.question: If [EX2-008 Guilmon]’s [On Play] effect reveals this card from my deck, can I add it to my hand as a card that has [Gallantmon] in its name?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I try to delete an opponent's Digimon with this card’s [When Digivolving] effect, and my opponent activates <Decoy> to prevent the chosen Digimon from being deleted. If the Digimon that activated <Decoy> is deleted, does the “if no Digimon was deleted by this effect” part of this card's effect still activate?
qa.answer: Yes. The Digimon chosen as a target for this effect is not deleted, and the Digimon that activates <Decoy> is deleted by the effect of <Decoy> and not this effect. As such, the condition is satisfied for "if no Digimon was deleted by this effect," and both players will trash the top 5 cards of their decks.

qa.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [ChaosGallantmon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [ChaosGallantmon].")
qa.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [ChaosGallantmon] name.

qa.question: I have 5 cards in my security stack. Can I still <Recovery +1 (Deck)> with this card?
qa.answer: No. This effect can only increase the number of cards in your security stack to 5 or less.

qa.question: With this card’s [End of Attack] effect, I place this Digimon under one of my other Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. What happens to the digivolution cards under this Digimon?
qa.answer:
They're trashed.
Only this card will be placed in your Digimon's digivolution cards by this effect.

qa.question: Can this card's [End of Attack] effect place this card under one of my Digimon that doesn't have a level?
qa.answer: Yes, it can.

qa.question: This card has two inherited effects. If this card becomes a digivolution card, can I activate both effects?
qa.answer: Yes, you can activate both.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [End of Attack] effect on this Digimon itself to place this card under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's Japanese [End of Attack] effect was corrected so that the target is "your other Digimon."
Please see the "Errata Cards" on the official website.

qa.question: If I have 4 black Tamers in play, can I gain 2 memory from this card’s inherited effect?
qa.answer: No. Even if you have 4 or more Tamers in play, you can only gain 1 memory.

qa.question: This card has gained <Piercing> from an effect. I have no Tamers in play, and this card attacks and deletes an opponent’s Digimon in battle and survives. Do I perform a security check due to <Piercing>?
qa.answer: Yes, even if you don't have any Tamers in play, <Piercing> still activates as normal.

qa.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon. If they block it with one of their Digimon, what happens?
qa.answer: If your Digimon is blocked by an opponent’s Digimon, the two Digimon battle as normal.

qa.question: Can this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect <De-Digivolve> an opponent’s Digimon when it unsuspends during my opponent’s unsuspend phase?
qa.answer: Yes, it can.

qa.question: During my opponent’s unsuspend phase, more than one of my opponent's Digimon become unsuspended. Do I choose which Digimon to <De-Digivolve> with this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you choose one of those Digimon to <De-Digivolve>.

qa.question: When an opponent’s Digimon becomes unsuspended, can I choose not to activate this card’s [Opponent's Turn] effect to <De-Digivolve> that Digimon in order to preserve the effect’s [Once Per Turn] limit?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: My opponent unsuspends a Digimon that has no digivolution cards or is level 3. Can I choose not to activate the <De-Digivolve> from this card’s [Opponent's Turn] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
<De-Digivolve> activates even if the opponent's Digimon that becomes unsuspended is level 3 or has no digivolution cards.

qa.question: Does this card’s [When Attacking] effect still activate even if I have no Tamers in play?
qa.answer: No. If you have no Tamers in play, the effect doesn't activate.

qa.question: If I have multiple Tamers in play, can I activate the same [When Digivolving] effect multiple times with this card's [When Attacking] effect?
qa.answer: Yes. You can activate the same [When Digivolving] effect as many times as you have Tamers in play.

qa.question: Can I activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" effect when this card is revealed from the deck or when searching/looking at this card in the deck?
qa.answer: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" when this card is directly trashed from the deck.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's 1st effect but choose to not trash any cards from my deck?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
If you activate this card's 1st effect, you must trash at least 1 card.
However, if you choose to not activate this effect, it won't activate and you don't trash any cards.

qa.question: Which player decides which cards are trashed from hand by this card’s [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: Both players decide which cards to trash from their own hands.

qa.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect activate before or after drawing the digivolution bonus card?
qa.answer:
It activates after you draw.
[When Digivolving] effects trigger after a player finishes drawing the digivolution bonus card.

qa.question: How does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect work when I have 5 or fewer cards in hand?
qa.answer: If you have 5 or fewer cards in hand, you don't trash any cards.

qa.question: Can I activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" effect when this card is revealed from the deck or when searching/looking at this card in the deck?
qa.answer: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" when this card is directly trashed from the deck.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect to reveal [EX2-045 Calumon] from my hand when my opponent plays a Lv.- [EX2-045 Calumon]?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
[EX2-045 Calumon] is a card with no level, so it isn't considered to have the same level even though it's the same card, and you can't use this card's effect to reveal it.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to trash [EX2-045 Calumon] from my hand when an opponent's Lv.- [EX2-045 Calumon] is deleted?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
[EX2-045 Calumon] is a card with no level, so it isn't considered to have the same level even though it's the same card, and you can't use this card's effect to trash it.

qa.question: Is a "if you don't have XX Digimon" condition also met when I have no Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, it's met.

qa.question: If cards that are targets of this effect are revealed from the deck, do I have to add as many cards to my hand as possible?
qa.answer: Yes, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: Can I activate this card’s [Main] effect when I don't have a [Mother D-Reaper] in the battle area?
qa.answer: Yes, you can. This card’s [Main] effect can be activated when there is no [Mother D-Reaper].

changes.before: [On Play][When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If one of your [Mother D-Reaper]s has 5 or more digivolution cards, reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 card with [D-Reaper] in its traits and a play cost of 10 or less among them without paying its memory cost. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
changes.after: [On Play][When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If one of your [Mother D-Reaper]s has 5 or more digivolution cards, reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 card with [D-Reaper] in its traits and a play cost of 10 or less among them without paying its memory cost. Place the remaining cards at the top of your deck in any order.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: If this card's effect plays a Digimon, is it treated as a Security Digimon even in my battle area?
qa.answer: No, it's treated as a normal Digimon once it comes into play.

qa.question: An opponent’s Digimon with <Security Attack+1> attacks me directly, and this card is flipped over during the first security check and played in my battle area by its [Security] effect. If I have a [Mother D-Reaper] with 6 or more digivolution cards in play, can this card's [Opponent’s Turn] effect prevent my opponent's second security check?
qa.answer: Yes. This card’s [Opponent's Turn] effect gives your opponent’s attacking Digimon <Security Attack -1> before the second security check, so the second security check does not occur, and the attack ends.

changes.before: When you would play this Digimon, you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]s to reduce this Digimon's play cost to 0.
changes.after: When you would play this Digimon, you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper], and this card is the bottom card. Does the "you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0" effect activate when my [EX2-055 Reaper] is played?
qa.answer: It can activate in such cases if you declare to trash 8 cards and then trash 7 cards except for [BT9-109 X Antibody].

qa.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under this card, and [BT9-109 X Antibody] is the bottom card. Does the "you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0" effect activate when my [EX2-055 Reaper] is played?
qa.answer: It can activate in such cases if you declare to trash 8 cards and then trash 7 cards except for [X Antibody].

qa.question: There are 8 digivolution cards under my EX2-007 [Mother D-Reaper], including 1 BT9-109 [X Antibody]. Can this card's 1st effect activate when this card would be played?
qa.answer: Yes, it can be activated. As long as you can trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom other than cards that can't be trashed, the play cost will be 0.

qa.question: When one of my Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon with [Gallantmon] or [Growlmon] in its name, if I can no longer pay the digivolution cost due to the inherited effect on my opponent's [EX3-016 SnowAgumon] or [EX3-019 Paledramon] and the digivolution fails, does the Digimon from the attempted digivolution still gain the [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect from this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes. This card's effect reads "when [...] would digivolve into," so the effect interrupts the digivolution when it activates. Therefore, it activates first and gives that Digimon <Blitz> even if the digivolution later fails.

qa.question: Can I activate this card’s effect when a Digimon in my breeding area digivolves into a level 5 or level 6 card?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't activate for Digimon in breeding areas.

qa.question: When one of my level 5 Digimon would digivolve into a level 6 and I delete that level 5 Digimon with this card's effect, what happens?
qa.answer: You can't continue the digivolution, and the level 6 Digimon card returns to your hand. The level 5 Digimon is deleted and no digivolution cost is paid.

qa.question: I used this card's [When Attacking] effect to digivolve into [Beelzemon] from my trash. At such times, can I use my [EX2-065 Ai & Mako]'s effect to digivolve again into a [Beelzemon: Blast Mode] in my trash?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I attack with my [Beelzemon Blast Mode]. Can I activate this card’s [Your Turn] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card can only be activated when you attack with a card explicitly named [Beelzemon].

qa.question: I used [ST14-02 Impmon] to attack, and its [When Attacking] effect digivolved it into [Beelzemon] from my trash. At such times, can I use this card's effect to again digivolve [Beelzemon] into [Beelzemon: Blast Mode] in my trash?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If my opponent has a Digimon with 3000 DP or less in play, can I choose not to delete an opponent’s Digimon intentionally but still <Draw 2>?
qa.answer: No. The effect doesn't read “you may,” so if a Digimon with 3000 DP or less is in play, you must choose it as part of the effect.

qa.question: Can I use this card to digivolve into a Digimon card with a special digivolution costing 3 or less?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use this card to DNA Digivolve into a Digimon card with a DNA Digivolution costing 3 or less?
qa.answer: No. The effect reads “You may digivolve 1 of your Digimon,” so you can’t use it to DNA Digivolve.

qa.question: Can I use this card to digivolve one of my Tamers into a Digimon that can digivolve from Tamers?
qa.answer: No. The effect reads “You may digivolve 1 of your Digimon,” so you can’t use it to digivolve a Tamer.

qa.question: Can I ignore digivolution requirements when digivolving by the effect of this card, as long as the cost is 3 or less?
qa.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can't ignore digivolution requirements unless some other effect that permits you to do so.

qa.question: I have a card in my hand with an effect that reads “1 of your Digimon may digivolve into this card in your hand for a digivolution cost of 3.” Can I use this card’ to digivolve into it?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I activate effects that reduce digivolution costs like <Digisorption> or [EX1-071 Win Rate: 60%!] to reduce the digivolution cost of a card in my hand from 4 or more to 3 or less, and then use this card to digivolve into it?
qa.answer: No, those effects are only active when the digivolution is taking place, which means they reduce the digivolution cost after a player has announced a digivolution. As such, at the time this card's effect is activated, the digivolution cost hasn't been reduced, and you can't choose the card with this card’s effect.

qa.question: I have a Digimon card with multiple digivolution requirements: one with a digivolution cost of 3, and one with a digivolution cost of 4. Can I use this card to digivolve into that Digimon card and apply the requirement with a cost of 4?
qa.answer: No. Even if the card has a digivolution requirement with a cost of 3, if you want to digivolve off the requirement with a cost of 4, you can’t use this card to digivolve.

qa.question: Can I activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" effect when this card is revealed from the deck or when searching/looking at this card in the deck?
qa.answer: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" when this card is directly trashed from the deck.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to reveal cards from my deck, but then choose to not digivolve?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can choose to not digivolve.
If you don't digivolve, you add 1 Digimon card among the revealed cards to your hand, then return all of the remaining cards to the bottom of your deck in any order.

qa.question: When a digivolution would occur by this card's [Main] effect, when exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw?
qa.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when this card is placed on top of that Digimon for the digivolution, and you draw from the unrevealed cards in your deck.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

qa.question: If I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before returning the remaining cards to the bottom of the deck?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 4 or fewer cards in my deck?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you reveal as many cards from your deck as possible.

qa.question: When this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect doesn't delete any of my opponent's Digimon, does the effect let it digivolve into [BT5-081 ChaosGallantmon], [BT9-017 Gallantmon (X Antibody)], or [EX2-073 Gallantmon Crimson Mode]?
qa.answer:
Digivolution into [BT9-017 Gallantmon (X Antibody)] is possible.
Digivolution into [BT5-081 ChaosGallantmon] isn't possible because the digivolution requirements aren't met.
[EX2-073 Gallantmon Crimson Mode] is level 7, so digivolution isn't possible.

qa.question: Do cards trashed from my opponent’s security stack by this card's [When Attacking] effect activate their [Security] effects?
qa.answer: No, the cards weren't being flipped over by a security check, so their [Security] effects don't activate.

qa.question: My opponent has 1 or more cards in their security stack. I attack my opponent with this Digimon and its [When Attacking] effect trashes their last security cards, leaving them with zero cards in their security stack. If the attack isn't blocked and my attack is successful when they have zero cards in their security stack, do I win the game?
qa.answer: Yes, you do.

qa.question: Can I activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" effect when this card is revealed from the deck or when searching/looking at this card in the deck?
qa.answer: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" when this card is directly trashed from the deck.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0224.title: <Recovery>
comprehensive-0224.text:
16-6. <Recovery>
16-6-1. <Recovery> is a keyword effect where the specified number of cards from the specified area are placed face down on top of the security stack. This is shown on cards using text such as <Recovery +1>.
16-6-2. <Recovery> effects execute processing.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0227.title: <Jamming>
comprehensive-0227.text:
16-9. <Jamming>
16-9-1. <Jamming> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect isn't deleted as a result of a battle with an opponent's Security Digimon.
16-9-2. <Jamming> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0231.title: <Retaliation>
comprehensive-0231.text:
16-13. <Retaliation>
16-13-1. <Retaliation> is a keyword effect where a battled opponent's Digimon is deleted when a Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle.
16-13-2. <Retaliation> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when just the Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-13-3. The processing from <Retaliation> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0233.title: <Rush>
comprehensive-0233.text:
16-15. <Rush>
16-15-1. <Rush> is a keyword effect where the Digimon with this effect can also attack in the same turn it was played.
16-15-2. <Rush> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0234.title: <Blitz>
comprehensive-0234.text:
16-16. <Blitz>
16-16-1. <Blitz> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect can attack if your opponent has 1 or more memory.
16-16-2. <Blitz> effects execute processing.
16-16-3. <Blitz> has a processing condition that requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side. "This Digimon may attack" is optional processing.
16-16-4. After using <Blitz> to make an attack declaration, the attack will proceed even if the memory moves to 0 or more.38
16-16-5. An attack can't be made using <Blitz> if the memory is at 0 or more upon activating <Blitz>.
